title: A Very Cold Day
content: Brrr! Imagine you are standing outside in the snow wearing only a T-shirt. Or imagine going out in the bright sun wearing a thick jacket. Sounds uncomfortable, right?

title: Think About It!
content: Why can't we wear the same dress every day? Why do we change our clothes when the weather changes?

content.title: Our Magic Shield
content.description: Just like a house protects us, clothes act like a magic shield around our body to protect us from weather.

title: Why We Wear Clothes
content: We wear clothes to cover our body. Clothes protect us from heat, cold, rain, and dust. They also make us look smart!

definition_snippet: Items worn to cover the body and protect it from weather.

question: What do clothes protect us from?

title: Reflection Time
content: Look at the clothes you are wearing right now. Are they light or heavy? Why did you choose to wear them today?

title: Connecting the Dots
content: Just like animals have fur or feathers to protect them, humans make clothes to protect themselves!

title: Weather Matching
content: Look out the window. Draw a picture of yourself wearing the perfect clothes for today's weather!

title: The Strange Wardrobe
content: Imagine wearing a thick woolen sweater on a hot sunny day on the beach. You would sweat so much!

title: What Would Happen?
content: How do you decide what to wear when it rains? Do you wear a cotton shirt?

content.title: The Fabric Magic
content.description: Different fabrics do different things. Cotton lets air in. Wool traps heat. Plastic stops water.

title: Seasons and Clothes
content: In summer, we wear light cotton clothes to keep cool. In winter, we wear woolen clothes to keep warm. When it rains, we use raincoats and umbrellas.

title: Fun Fact
content: We get cotton from cotton plants and wool from sheep!

definition_snippet: Light clothes made from cotton plants, worn in summer.
Warm clothes made from sheep's wool, worn in winter.

question: What kind of clothes should we wear in winter?
Which clothes keep our body cool?

title: Your Favorite Season
content: Think about your favorite season. What is your favorite dress to wear in that season?

title: Where does it come from?
content: Clothes connect us to nature! Plants give us cotton, and animals like sheep give us wool.

title: Sorting Game
content: Open your cupboard. Pick one dress for summer, one for winter, and one for a rainy day.

title: Don't get confused!
content: An umbrella is not a cloth, but it is an accessory we use on rainy days to stay dry!

title: The Army of Clones?
content: Have you ever seen police officers, nurses, or a group of students from the same school? They all look exactly the same!

title: Why Match?
content: Why do children in a school wear the same dress? What if everyone wore whatever they wanted to school?

content.title: A Team Symbol
content.description: Just like a sports team wears the same color, some jobs and schools use special clothes so we can easily recognize them.

title: What is a Uniform?
content: Special clothes that people wear to work or school are called uniforms. Doctors, policemen, postmen, and students wear uniforms.

definition_snippet: A special set of clothes worn by all members of an organization or school.

question: Who among the following wears a uniform?

title: Look at Your Uniform
content: How do you feel when you wear your school uniform? Does it make you feel like part of a big team?

title: Community Helpers
content: Uniforms help us quickly identify community helpers in an emergency. If you are lost, you can easily spot a police officer by their uniform!

title: Design a Uniform
content: Imagine you are the captain of a spaceship. Draw the uniform you and your crew would wear!
